text:
maria: Quick async check — Packaging change (v2 ratecard rollout). We need final metering mapping + quota behavior documented before we flip the feature flag. Owners: product (maria), eng (jonas), billing (sam), legal (anya). Can everyone confirm blockers?

jonas: Eng status — PR open for adapter + tests: https://git.redwood/infra/packaging-adapter/pull/442. Waiting on two mapping keys from billing: `unit_type` and `window_align`. Everything else is green.

sam: Billing update — I have a draft mapping worksheet. Two policy questions: 1) do we grandfather existing customers to per-seat for 6 months? 2) hourly vs daily aggregation for quota enforcement (affects rate-limit impl). Uploaded CSV to drive: https://drive.redwood/sheets/packaging-metering-v2.csv

anya: Legal — Contract note: if we expose both per-seat and per-usage pricing we need a default termination/overage clause. I'll send redlines by EOD. Also need confirmation if quota changes are considered material for existing contracts.

maria: Thanks. Action items: sam confirms final JSON mapping + examples (by tomorrow 12pm PT), anya provides redlines (EOD), jonas will gate PR until mappings are final. If any party misses deadline we delay feature flag.

jonas: One small ask from eng: include an explicit `granularity` field in the mapping (`minute|hour|day`) so adapter can pick batch window. Current PR defaults to `hour` but we should be explicit. Suggestion: mapping example below:

```
{
  "meter_id": "tokens_generated",
  "unit_type": "token",
  "granularity": "hour",
  "window_align": "utc",
  "quota_per_window": 1000000
}
```

sam: Agree to `granularity`. Regarding grandfathering — ops prefers 3 months not 6. I can make the mapping and a migration plan (how we backfill quota) if we get signoff. Also need to confirm billing export column names; current export tool expects `usage_units` and `customer_id`. If mapping changes, we must update the export Lambda.

maria: OK — tentative plan: 3-month grandfather with opt-in extension for enterprise. Sam: add migration plan + export updates to the sheet and ping eng.

anya: I flagged the termination/overage clause as a must-have. If product wants to proceed without it we need an exec exception. I prefer to have redlines in place.

jonas: Noted. For the adapter I can add a backwards-compat flag so exports accept both old and new column names for 30 days. That reduces blast radius. Will add to PR description.

sam: Uploaded updated mapping + migration checklist at 2065432120 in the sheet. Also pasted a small sample mapping in the comments section of the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy check — no config changes yet. When mapping.json lands and legal signs off, run `./ops/deploy.sh --staging-packaging` and notify #eng-release.

maria: Great. Final checklist (repeat): sam -> final mapping + migration plan (tomorrow 12pm PT); anya -> redlines (EOD); jonas -> adapter PR gated until mapping + backward-compat flag added; I'll coordinate doc updates and schedule a 15m sync only if anything slips. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup:
